# Sample planning note — interference checklist

Source-id: sample-interference
Locator: section-3

If a mid-band cell shows elevated BLER together with stable or rising drop rate, walk this interference checklist:

1. External interference sweep on the uplink.
2. Downlink SINR distribution versus RSRP. Poor SINR with strong RSRP suggests interference rather than coverage.
3. Neighbour relation completeness and forbidden lists.
4. Almost-blank or power-sharing settings if a second carrier is active.

Cite this checklist only when retrieval selected it. It is sample guidance, not a 3GPP extract.
